input.summary: Add HDI (vendor) indemnity for third-party IP claims, breach of law, HDI-caused data incidents and misconduct
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity at all, so we have added an HDI indemnity covering third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Site and HDI's services, HDI's breach of law, HDI-caused data incidents and HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct, with standard notice, control and cooperation mechanics. HDI builds, hosts and operates the Site, so it should stand behind claims arising from what it delivers; we can discuss customary IP exclusions (Company Content, Marks, specifications and modifications) if helpful.

ops.text: Indemnification by HDI. HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, losses, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (1) an allegation that the Site, the services performed by HDI hereunder or any software, systems or materials provided by HDI (excluding Content or Marks provided by the Company) infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (2) HDI's breach of applicable law; (3) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Content, Confidential Information or customer or user data caused by HDI; or (4) HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The Company shall promptly notify HDI of any such claim, HDI shall have control of the defense and settlement thereof (provided that no settlement imposing any liability, obligation or admission on the Company shall be entered into without the Company's prior written consent), and the Company shall provide reasonable cooperation at HDI's expense.
